description: A major player in the consumer packaged goods sector, Kraft Heinz makes everything from cream cheese to soup to, of course, ketchup. It’s also the home of well-known snack brand staples, including Jell-O and Lunchables. With a long history dating back to 1869, when Henry Heinz began selling his first product (bottled horseradish), the company changed its name to the Kraft Heinz Co. after a merger in 2015.

rankings.itemDescription: Kraft-Heinz is the third-largest food and beverage company in North America and the fifth-largest in the world. As the closure of restaurants forced more to eat at home, the company thrived, and first quarter 2021 results showed net sales increased 3.9% year over year.
